BiblicalUsage: The word means to transfer from one tongue to another. In Ezra's day a letter to Artaxerxes was written in the Syrian tongue and interpreted in the Syrian tongue, and the whole opposition to the rebuilding turned on what the letter said.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the quiet reminder here is that translation is never a small thing: kingdoms and building projects can turn on how words cross from one language to another.
